verdict.rationale: Figma Make's docs only show viewing and editing app files in-product (docs-7) and copying preview snapshots as layers into Figma Design (docs-4). Neither is a documented export of all data in open formats. Community reports say the API rejects .make files and that users had to reverse-engineer an undocumented binary format to get their code out, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
